The reconciliation process begins with fixing the locateDocumentRegion bug, ensuring that all 968 CITABLE_VERIFIED records satisfy L1-L4 provenance criteria. This guarantees that each record is verifiable through byte-exact substring matches and domain vocabulary alignment. The X20 defect in do-calculus-id.ts arises from incorrect marginalization—specifically, Line 6 returns a product over observational distributions instead of the current marginalized distribution. Correcting this requires tracing the ID algorithm through the canonical graph structure, where marginalizing over W removes the directed path from Z to X, leaving only the edge W → Y. The resulting expression becomes a sum over W of the product of conditional probabilities, which correctly reflects the causal structure. The ProximalBridgeIDEngine then addresses cases where mediators are absent, using Fredholm integral equations to compute causal effects via negative controls. These steps ensure that GSE’s causal architecture remains consistent with both structural and numerical integrity.
